_note: Production menu data for both concept sites (Bazaar + Royal), built from data/menu.skeleton.json. Names come from public listing snippets and are unverified against the live menu. Diet, spice and copy are estimates written by the copywriter; see data/MENU_README.md for the schema and the owner-confirmation list.

meta.disclaimer: Menu shown is a design concept built from public listings; dishes, spice levels and prices to be synced with the live menu.
meta.allergenNote: Tell us about any allergies when you order — our kitchen handles nuts, dairy, gluten, shellfish and eggs, so we can't promise an allergen-free dish.
meta.spiceNote: Spice levels are our estimates of each dish as usually made. Many dishes can be ordered mild, medium or spicy, so just ask.
meta.dietNote: Diet marks reflect how each dish is usually made and are pending kitchen confirmation.

items.desc_royal: Tender goat in a gentle, ivory kurma, softly spiced and rich.

items.name: Goat Chettinad
items.desc_neutral: Goat in a peppery Chettinad-style masala of roasted spices.
items.desc_bazaar: Goat meets Chettinad pepper punch. Bring your A-game.
items.desc_royal: Goat in a dark, roasted Chettinad masala, peppery and profound.

items.name: Rogan Goat Curry
items.desc_neutral: Goat in an aromatic red rogan gravy, deep in colour, warm in spice.
items.desc_bazaar: Red, rich and rogan-ready. Goat curry with main-character energy.
items.desc_royal: Goat in a crimson, aromatic rogan, layered with warm whole spice.

items.name: Lamb Curry
items.desc_neutral: Lamb slow-cooked in a spiced onion-tomato gravy.
items.desc_bazaar: Tender lamb, rich gravy, happy you. Simple as that.
items.desc_royal: Lamb, slow-simmered to tenderness in a warm, spiced onion gravy.

items.name: Andhra Lamb Curry
items.desc_neutral: Lamb in a fiery Andhra-style gravy of red chillies and spices.
items.desc_bazaar: Lamb with Andhra fire. Sweat a little, smile a lot.
items.desc_royal: Lamb in a bold Andhra red-chilli gravy, fierce and deeply savoury.

items.name: Lamb Kurma
items.desc_neutral: Lamb in a mild, creamy kurma gravy.
items.desc_bazaar: Creamy, mellow, melt-in-your-mouth lamb. Kurma comfort mode: on.
items.desc_royal: Tender lamb in a soft, ivory kurma, gently spiced and rich.

items.name: Lamb Vindaloo
items.desc_neutral: Lamb in a fiery, tangy curry of red chillies, vinegar and spices.
items.desc_bazaar: Lamb vindaloo: hot, tangy, unforgettable. Mild people, look away!
items.desc_royal: Lamb in a fierce, vinegar-bright vindaloo with a long, slow burn.

items.name: Kadai Lamb
items.desc_neutral: Lamb cooked in a kadai with bell peppers, onions and coarsely ground spices.
items.desc_bazaar: Lamb, peppers, kadai masala. Chunky, punchy, proper feast.
items.desc_royal: Tender lamb and sweet peppers, seared in a kadai with toasted spice.

items.name: Garlic Naan
items.desc_neutral: Tandoor-baked naan topped with chopped garlic.
items.desc_bazaar: Bas, ek aur naan. Okay, ek aur. Garlicky, blistered, addictive.
items.desc_royal: Pillowy naan, blistered in the tandoor and scattered with golden garlic.

items.name: Butter Naan
items.desc_neutral: Tandoor-baked naan brushed with butter.
items.desc_bazaar: Soft, buttery, pull-apart perfection. Curry's favourite scoop.
items.desc_royal: Soft tandoor naan, glistening with a brush of melted butter.
items.desc_src: Tandoor-baked white-flour naan brushed with butter.

items.name: Plain Naan
items.desc_neutral: Classic leavened flatbread baked in the tandoor.
items.desc_bazaar: The OG scooper. Soft, puffy, ready for gravy duty.
items.desc_royal: Simple, pillowy naan, blistered against the hot tandoor wall.

items.name: Roti / Chapati
items.desc_neutral: Two whole-wheat flatbreads, soft and unleavened.
items.desc_bazaar: Whole-wheat, soft and everyday-easy. Roti, sabzi, done!
items.desc_royal: Soft, whole-wheat rounds, the quiet companion to every curry.

items.name: Bullet Naan
items.desc_neutral: Naan topped with chopped green chillies and herbs, baked in the tandoor.
items.desc_bazaar: Naan with a kick: green chillies baked right in. Pow!
items.desc_royal: Tandoor naan, flecked with green chilli for a bright, lively heat.

items.name: Paratha
items.desc_neutral: Flaky, layered flatbread, griddled until golden; two pieces.
items.desc_bazaar: Flaky layers, golden edges. Peel, tear, dunk, repeat.
items.desc_royal: Layer upon flaky layer, griddled golden and gently crisp.

items.name: Plain Basmati Rice
items.desc_neutral: Steamed basmati rice.
items.desc_bazaar: Fluffy basmati: the curry's best friend.
items.desc_royal: Long, separate grains of steamed basmati, ready for every gravy.

items.name: Shrimp Pulav
items.desc_neutral: Pulav rice cooked with whole spices and masala-tossed shrimp.
items.desc_bazaar: Shrimp + pulav = happy plate, happier you.
items.desc_royal: Delicate shrimp, folded into softly spiced, fragrant pulav.

items.name: Gulab Jamun
items.desc_neutral: Soft fried milk-solid dumplings soaked in sugar syrup.
items.desc_bazaar: Syrupy, squishy, golden-brown happiness. Meetha moment unlocked!
items.desc_royal: Tender, golden dumplings, steeped in a fragrant sugar syrup.
items.desc_src: Soft milk-solid dumplings in sugar syrup.

items.name: Rasmalai
items.desc_neutral: Soft cheese dumplings in chilled, sweetened, cardamom-scented milk.
items.desc_bazaar: Soft, spongy, milky magic. Thanda, meetha, perfect.
items.desc_royal: Pillowy cheese dumplings, adrift in chilled milk that smells of cardamom.
items.desc_src: Soft cheese dumplings in chilled, sweetened, cardamom-scented milk.

items.name: Carrot Halwa
items.desc_neutral: Grated carrots slow-cooked with milk and sugar into a rich pudding.
items.desc_bazaar: Carrots, but make it dessert. Gajar halwa, ekdum mast!
items.desc_royal: Grated carrots, slow-cooked in milk until jewel-bright and sweet.

items.name: Rice Kheer
items.desc_neutral: Creamy pudding of rice slow-cooked in sweetened milk.
items.desc_bazaar: Creamy rice pudding, desi-style. Spoon in, stress out.
items.desc_royal: Rice, slow-simmered in sweetened milk to a soft, creamy hush.

items.name: Ice Cream
items.desc_neutral: Ice cream; ask about today's flavours.
items.desc_bazaar: Cool down that chilli heat. Ask what flavours we've got!
items.desc_royal: A cool, simple finish. Ask us about today's flavours.

items.name: Rabidi Jamun
items.desc_neutral: Gulab jamun served with rabidi (rabri), a thickened, sweetened milk.
items.desc_bazaar: Gulab jamun in a rabidi bath. Double the sweet, double the joy!
items.desc_royal: Gulab jamun, draped in rabidi: slow-reduced, sweet, creamy milk.
items.desc_src: Gulab jamun served with rabri (thickened sweet milk). Description inferred from the dish name; the restaurant's wording was not found.

items.name: Kala Jamun
items.desc_neutral: Dark, deep-fried milk-solid dumplings soaked in sugar syrup.
items.desc_bazaar: Gulab jamun's darker, richer sibling. Kala means black. Also: delicious.
items.desc_royal: Deeply caramelised dumplings, dark as dusk, steeped in syrup.
items.desc_src: Dark, deep-fried milk dumplings in syrup (kala jamun). Description inferred from the dish name.

items.name: Apricot Delight
items.desc_neutral: A sweet dessert built around stewed apricots.
items.desc_bazaar: Apricots in dessert mode. Fruity, sweet, ekdum delightful.
items.desc_royal: Sweet stewed apricots, a jewel-toned finale to the feast.

items.name: Mango Lassi
items.desc_neutral: Chilled yogurt blended with ripe mango; sweet and tangy.
items.desc_bazaar: Thandi, creamy, mango-y. Your chilli-fire extinguisher.
items.desc_royal: Ripe mango and cool yogurt, with a whisper of cardamom.
items.desc_src: Creamy yogurt blended with ripe mango. Sweet and tangy. The DoorDash-style listing adds milk, sugar and a hint of cardamom.

items.name: Sweet Lassi
items.desc_neutral: Chilled yogurt drink, blended smooth and sweetened.
items.desc_bazaar: Cool, sweet, frothy lassi. Sip, sigh, repeat.
items.desc_royal: Cool, sweetened yogurt, whisked to a soft, silken froth.

items.name: Mango Milkshake
items.desc_neutral: Chilled milk blended with mango.
items.desc_bazaar: Mango + milk + chill = instant summer, all year.
items.desc_royal: Cold milk and golden mango, blended smooth and sunny.

items.name: Chikku Shake
items.desc_neutral: Milkshake blended with chikku (sapota), a soft, caramel-sweet tropical fruit.
items.desc_bazaar: Chikku: tastes like brown sugar grew on a tree. Shake it!
items.desc_royal: Chikku, the caramel-sweet sapota, blended into a cool, creamy shake.
items.desc_src: Chikoo (sapota) milkshake. Spelled 'Chikku' in the source.

items.name: Sitaphal Shake
items.desc_neutral: Milkshake blended with sitaphal (custard apple), creamy and sweet.
items.desc_bazaar: Custard apple in a glass. Creamy, dreamy, desi-delicious.
items.desc_royal: Sitaphal, the custard apple, blended cool, creamy and gently floral.
items.desc_src: Custard-apple (sitaphal) milkshake. Spelled 'Sitaphai' in the source; the spelling needs checking against the real menu.

items.name: Badam Milk
items.desc_neutral: Sweetened milk flavoured with almonds (badam).
items.desc_bazaar: Badam = almond. Milk = yes. Sweet, nutty, totally sippable.
items.desc_royal: Sweet milk, rich with ground almonds, smooth and comforting.

items.name: Buttermilk
items.desc_neutral: Thin, savoury yogurt cooler, lightly spiced.
items.desc_bazaar: Tangy, savoury, ice-cool. The desi way to chill after spice.
items.desc_royal: Cool, savoury buttermilk, gently seasoned and wonderfully refreshing.

items.name: Chai
items.desc_neutral: Hot Indian tea brewed with milk and sugar.
items.desc_bazaar: Chai-lo! Garam chai, good gossip, zero rush.
items.desc_royal: Hot, milky tea, poured slow: the gentlest way to end a meal.
items.desc_src: Hot Indian tea listed under Hot Beverages. Other hot drinks (for example coffee) were not confirmed.

offers.title: Weekend Family Pack
offers.detail: Family-size biryani and pulav packs come with a free appetizer and dessert, chef's choice.
offers.line_bazaar: Feed the whole gang: family biryani, plus a free starter and dessert!
offers.line_royal: For the weekend table: family-size biryani, with a starter and sweet on us.
offers.source: Official site category summary ('family pack options that include free appetizer and dessert'); pack list from one delivery-app listing.

offers.title: Biryani Combo, Tuesdays & Wednesdays
offers.detail: A biryani combo offer runs on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. What's included is to be confirmed.
offers.line_royal: Midweek, made better: a biryani combo every Tuesday and Wednesday.
offers.source: DoorDash listing ('Biryani's Combo Offer', Tuesday and Wednesday only). A third-party promo page names a Wednesday multi-biryani special (single source, not cross-checked; do not publish its terms).

offers.title: Lunch Box
offers.detail: Lunch Box options are listed for online ordering. Contents to be confirmed.
offers.source: DoorDash 'Lunch Box' menu section (contents and price not seen).

offers.title: Catering & Party Platters
offers.detail: Outdoor catering for special occasions, plus pre-booked platters for large groups. Details on request.
offers.line_bazaar: Party at yours? We'll bring the biryani.
offers.line_royal: Celebrations, catered: pre-booked platters for your gathering.
offers.source: Official site has a catering page (unreadable); Sulekha describes outdoor catering and pre-booked large-group platters.
